holdout_G1.use: primary holdout of this pack's runner (single use)

holdout_G2.use: reserved: only after a written, QA-approved protocol change, before any game of it

qa_book_alternative.rule: every played opening of a QA confirmation is audited (bin/confirm.ps1 -Command audit); claim only if leakage <= 1% of pairs

single_use_rule: confirm_runner.py registry: a holdout group serves exactly one confirmation, ever. Refused: a group registered from another directory, and a re-run in the same directory after its CONFIRM.json is gone. A resume must keep protocol and candidate. The registry line is written just before the first pair is recorded, after every mode prerequisite has passed, to the protocol's registry and to <holdout file>.registry.jsonl. An interim replay (no decision, fewer pairs than the cap) is refused before writing. Synthetic and test-only runs use .synthetic registries. This is an accident guard, not a security boundary.
